key_insight: Adding an EHR-integrated radiologist dashboard did not make STAT chest radiograph reports more specific, but it slightly improved diagnostic concordance and reduced follow-up chest CT use.
clinical_relevance: Better access to patient context may help align abnormal chest X-ray impressions with discharge diagnoses and modestly reduce downstream imaging, without changing reporting speed or antibiotic/diuretic ordering.
method: Stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial across 15 service areas in an integrated health system
404,860 ED and inpatient STAT chest radiographs interpreted by 387 radiologists
AI-assisted report classification and mixed-effects modeling adjusted for time, age, view, and clustering
evidence_signal: The study found no change in overall specificity, a small increase in abnormal report-discharge concordance, and a small decrease in follow-up chest CT, based on large-scale real-world trial data.
watch_item: The clinical impact was modest, and the use of LLM-based report classification introduces implementation and generalizability concerns that may affect adoption across settings.
paper_title: Effect of an Electronic Health Record-Integrated Clinical Dashboard for Radiologists on STAT Priority Chest Radiograph Reporting and Downstream Care: A Stepped-Wedge Cluster Randomized Trial
